title: ci: keep the PR review running after its engine moved to wachi-reviewer
body:
The engine repository was renamed from `niway-dev/agent-review` to `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer` (its ADR 0005). GitHub does not redirect `uses:` to a renamed repository, so the old path fails with "repository not found". Only the repository part of `uses:` changes; the tag stays `v1`. Pinning to an exact release follows in #401.
